excerpt: An 11x7 cedar greenhouse with a pergola entrance, 83 sq ft of floor, 40 linear feet of staging and a 5,700 lb snow rating.
description:
The Bellerose puts a pergola and trellis roof over its entrance, so climbing vines and hanging baskets get growing room before you even step inside. Behind it sits 83 square feet of floor and 40 linear feet of staging shelving, part fixed and part foldable, so a bench can drop away when something tall needs the height.
Glazing is 10mm four-wall polycarbonate rated R-2.1. It holds roughly 30% more heat than the 6mm twin-wall used on most greenhouses this size, and it diffuses light rather than focusing it, so seedlings get even coverage instead of scorch marks. Airflow is handled by a thermostat-activated exhaust fan and two casement windows, which between them cover both still summer afternoons and damp spring mornings.
The frame is FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar, a timber that resists rot and insects without chemical treatment. An interior water spigot means watering happens where the plants are. The structure is tested to 5,700 lb of snow load and 100 mph winds, so a hard winter is a design case rather than a worry.
highlights: 83 sq ft interior with 40 linear feet of fixed and foldable staging shelves
10mm four-wall polycarbonate, R-2.1 — about 30% more heat retention than 6mm twin-wall
FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar frame, naturally rot and insect resistant
Thermostat-activated exhaust fan plus two casement windows
Integrated pergola with trellis roof over the entrance
Interior water spigot included
Tested to 5,700 lb snow load and 100 mph winds
Diffused light transmission protects seedlings from scorch

excerpt: An 11x7 cedar greenhouse with a three-sided trellis roof, 78 sq ft inside and 45 linear feet of staging including a 4-tier rack.
description:
The Poppy extends its trellis roof across three sides, which turns the outside of the greenhouse into growing space as well as the inside. Hanging baskets, trailing plants and climbing vines all get a frame to work along.
Inside there are 78 square feet of floor and 45 linear feet of staging, upper and lower, including a freestanding four-tier rack that takes pots off the ground without eating bench space. Glazing is 10mm four-wall polycarbonate rated R-2.1, holding around 30% more heat than the 6mm twin-wall common at this size while diffusing direct sun into even light.
Ventilation runs on a thermostat-activated exhaust fan with two casement windows for passive airflow. The frame is FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar, which resists rot, decay and insects without treatment. An interior spigot and collapsible hose are included, and the structure is tested to 4,200 lb of snow load and 100 mph winds.

Extended three-sided trellis roof for baskets and climbing vines
10mm four-wall polycarbonate, R-2.1 — about 30% more heat retention than 6mm twin-wall
FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar frame, naturally rot and insect resistant
Thermostat-activated exhaust fan plus two casement windows
Interior water spigot with collapsible hose included
Tested to 4,200 lb snow load and 100 mph winds
Diffused light transmission protects seedlings from scorch

excerpt: A 12x7 cedar greenhouse with a sloped roof, 86 sq ft of floor and foldable staging that clears space for tall plants.
description:
The Zalie takes a sloped roof and plain architectural lines, which keeps it looking deliberate in a garden rather than utilitarian. Inside are 86 square feet of floor with 23 linear feet of staging. Some of those shelves are fixed and some fold down, so the bench can disappear when a tomato crop or a potting project needs the headroom.
Every roof and window panel is 10mm four-wall polycarbonate rated R-2.1, retaining about 30% more heat than the 6mm twin-wall most greenhouses use, and turning direct sun into diffused light. Airflow comes from a thermostat-activated exhaust fan and two drop-down windows.
The frame is FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar, which handles humidity and seasonal movement without the rot that catches untreated softwood. An interior water spigot is included, and the structure is tested to 4,400 lb of snow load and 100 mph winds.

Sloped roof with clean architectural lines

FSC-certified kiln-dried cedar frame, naturally rot and insect resistant
Thermostat-activated exhaust fan plus two drop-down windows

Tested to 4,400 lb snow load and 100 mph winds
